$comment: Checked-in team defaults. Machine-specific paths and any tokens stay in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Keep this file secret-free. If the default branch is not 'main', add env.SPRINT_MAIN_BRANCH (the full-tier sprint scripts read it). The hooks block runs scripts/hooks/guard.mjs before Bash/edit/StructuredOutput calls (main-branch protection in both tiers; file-claim, lifecycle and completion guards in the full tier) and scripts/hooks/agent-log.mjs on subagent start/stop. /template-upgrade owns every hook group whose handlers all run scripts under scripts/hooks/ — add your own hooks as separate groups and they are preserved. Unattended runs need auto mode set in USER settings (~/.claude/settings.json): a defaultMode of auto or bypassPermissions in this file is ignored by Claude Code.
